Important information

Safety Information

Keep out of reach of children.

Directions

Wet the toothbrush head and apply toothpaste. Guide the toothbrush along all tooth surfaces in a gentle, circular motion. Brush the tongue and inside of cheeks. Brush for two minutes. Replace the brush head every three months. Refer to the user manual for specific instructions related to charging and using different modes.

Product Description

The Philips Sonicare ProtectiveClean 5300 electric sonic toothbrush offers a significant improvement in your dental hygiene routine, promoting wellness by enhancing your gum health up to 100% vs. a manual toothbrush. With a pressure sensor, 3 brushing modes and 3 intensity settings, this electric toothbrush is tailored to protect sensitive gums and optimize your brushing experience. Clean mode is standard for superior cleaning, White is the ideal mode for removing surface stains, and Gum Care mode adds an extra minute of reduced-power brushing, so you can gently massage your gums. The G2 Optimal Gum Care brush head provides effective clean while being gentle on gums. Click on the DiamondClean brush head to remove surface stains and reveal a whiter smile. The 2-minute Smartimer and QuadPacer help you achieve a dental professional-recommended brushing time, promoting optimal oral health. The Philips ProtectiveClean 5300 is a reliable companion, at home or on the go − it works perfectly as a travel toothbrush as well. The set includes a travel case and a charger to maintain its long-lasting lithium-ion battery that operates for up to two weeks on a single charge. The BrushSync technology tracks how long you've been using your brush head for, and how hard you've been brushing.The BrushSync replacement reminder on your handle and a short beep gives you a heads up when it's time to replace the brush head. With its sleek black design and ergonomic handle, the Philips ProtectiveClean 5300 not only prioritizes your oral health but also delivers comfort and durability, making it a smart addition to your wellness routine. Make the switch to a Philips Sonicare toothbrush and feel the difference.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Never manual again
Honestly, I was hesitant to buy an electric toothbrush, but I’d always wanted to try one. So I looked up reviews everywhere—videos, expert opinions, and everything else. I know it might’ve been a bit much, but let’s be real: when it comes to price, you think twice. In this case, I took advantage of an Amazon deal and decided to go for it. I compared several brands—some even offered 3D videos—but hey, it’s a toothbrush, not a trip to the moon. The prices of other models seemed outrageous and overly complicated, so I went with this brand and model, and honestly, I’m surprised I didn’t do it sooner. For me, it’s the best way to brush, and I’m not going back to manual—I feel my teeth are much cleaner and I can really notice the difference. It’s not the cheapest option (more of a mid-range), but I think it’s more than enough—again, it’s not a trip to the moon. You do need to learn how to use it (which is super easy), and it even comes with a manual, plus you can download the digital version online. As a bonus, they include two brush heads and a beautiful, practical case.

    A great option over a standard toothbrush
    Reviewed in the United States on February 24, 2025

    What started as having just one of these in our household has turned into the whole family using these Sonicare toothbrushes. Having considered all the various models this particular one proved perfect for our use case. We have 5 of these in our household. We do have the white and black models and either are based on preference but over time I tend to think that even though the black (this model) might show residue easier that also makes it easier to see and clean and it's possible the white could discolor over time.

    The travel case is a nice feature to have. Have not traveled with it as of yet to see how functional and how much room it may consume if trying to travel light but it's there. The is not enough room to also store the charger in the case but will hold the handle and the brush (separated from the handle) in the included durable travel case. It does come with two additional brushes which is nice. The charging base is a standard two prong plug. Be cautious as some models seem to have a USB charging base that would require an additional purchase of a charger to charge in a standard outlet.

    This model has three settings with lighting for each. The bottom of the two buttons easily move through each setting with each press. There is a low battery indicator as well.

    Brushing with this is amazing. It's much more effective than a standard toothbrush or any standard electric toothbrush used over time. Even the kids notice how much cleaner their teeth seem after a use. Brushing harder is not good on teeth as any dentist has told me over time so this brush helps regulate how you brush. You don't have to brush with the Sonicare. The Sonicare does the brushing. You can simply slowly guide the brush over your teeth and let the Sonicare do its job. If the brush is pressed too hard against the teeth the Sonicare vibrations will halt as a sign you are trying to brush too hard.

    Overall this device is highly recommended and it's even better if you watch for a good deal that does or had occurred periodically.

    I am a lifelong manual medium bristles toothbrush user. Over the years, I have seen electric toothbrushes in my friend's and family's bathrooms and never thought I would ever want to use one.

    After doing some research, I decided to buy this electric toothbrush. At first, I was not sure if the small brush head would do as good of a job as my standard size manual toothbrush. It took me two days and four brushings to get use to it. The small brush head did a better job at cleaning my teeth. I can not believe how clean my teeth feel after brushing 2 minutes with this toothbrush. Even my gumline has felt cleaner after brushing with this thing multiple times for a week. With my manual toothbrush, there were times I could feel that my gumline was not as clean as it should be. Never once did I irritate my gums while brushing like I did with my manual toothbrush many of times. The electric toothbrush pressure sensor prevented me from doing that to my gums.

    The 2-minute timer for the clean mode is good for me. After brushing teeth, I switch the intensity to the gum care mode to clean my gums. I like how the brush head replacement reminder and pressure sensor can be deactivated if you do not like those features. My traveling case struggles to stay closed. I may have to buy a different one for traveling with this electric toothbrush.

    I am impressed with it and wished that I would have bought one of these years ago.

    1-24-26

    I'm not impressed with the charger. If I use the toothbrush until the battery indicator starts to flash auburn color LED, it takes more than eight hours to fully charge the battery. There is not enough counter space for me to keep the toothbrush docked on the charger. My Philips Norelco All-in-One Series 9000 Trimmer, Wahl Pro Series Detail Trimmer, and Wahl Lithium Ion Pro Rechargeable Cordless Hair Clippers all charge faster than this thing. Heck, a Dewalt 6Ah battery chargers faster than this toothbrush.

    I bought this toothbrush because my old model that’s no longer made had quietly become my go‑to—and I’m thrilled this one kept all the features I loved and then added a few extras.

    It came highly recommended by my dentist, and I’ve been using it steadily since. It gives that same clean, confident feeling and upgrades things like pressure sensing and smarter modes.

    Pros:

    Pressure sensor alerts you if you’re brushing too hard, love this for protecting my gums.

    Three cleaning modes (Clean / White / Gum Care), gives flexibility depending on what my mouth needs.

    BrushSync tech: the handle knows when the brush head needs replacing, so you’re not guessing.

    Travel case included, long battery life, solid extras.

    Cons:

    It’s a bit more expensive than my previous toothbrush, but honestly, worth it for the functionality.

    If you absolutely cannot stand any kind of tech beep or smart reminder, the extra features might feel like “too much.”

    I’m still waiting to see how long the rechargeable battery lasts compared to the old model.

    Final Thoughts:

    If you’re upgrading from a standard electric brush or your model is now discontinued (like mine), this one hits the spot. It keeps the trusted parts I loved and adds smart features I didn’t know I needed. Would absolutely recommend for anyone serious about brushing right.

About this Item

  • Smart Brushing: Pressure sensor alerts you to protect gums and optimize cleaning
  • Customizable Modes: Choose from Clean, White, or Gum Care for tailored oral care
  • BrushSync Technology: Reminds you to replace brush head for effective cleaning
  • Electric Toothbrush with Timer: 2-minute Smartimer and QuadPacer for optimal brushing
  • Long Battery Life: Up to 2 weeks of use on a single charge, perfect for travel
  • Stylish Design: Sleek black electric toothbrush complements any bathroom decor
  • Travel Ready: Comes with a travel case for convenient on-the-go oral care
  • The box includes: 1x handle, 1x G2 Optimal Gum Care brush head, 2x DiamondClean brush heads, 1x travel case, 1x charger

Product Description

The Philips Sonicare ProtectiveClean 5300 electric sonic toothbrush offers a significant improvement in your dental hygiene routine, promoting wellness by enhancing your gum health up to 100% vs. a manual toothbrush. With a pressure sensor, 3 brushing modes and 3 intensity settings, this electric toothbrush is tailored to protect sensitive gums and optimize your brushing experience. Clean mode is standard for superior cleaning, White is the ideal mode for removing surface stains, and Gum Care mode adds an extra minute of reduced-power brushing, so you can gently massage your gums. The G2 Optimal Gum Care brush head provides effective clean while being gentle on gums. Click on the DiamondClean brush head to remove surface stains and reveal a whiter smile. The 2-minute Smartimer and QuadPacer help you achieve a dental professional-recommended brushing time, promoting optimal oral health. The Philips ProtectiveClean 5300 is a reliable companion, at home or on the go − it works perfectly as a travel toothbrush as well. The set includes a travel case and a charger to maintain its long-lasting lithium-ion battery that operates for up to two weeks on a single charge. The BrushSync technology tracks how long you've been using your brush head for, and how hard you've been brushing.The BrushSync replacement reminder on your handle and a short beep gives you a heads up when it's time to replace the brush head. With its sleek black design and ergonomic handle, the Philips ProtectiveClean 5300 not only prioritizes your oral health but also delivers comfort and durability, making it a smart addition to your wellness routine. Make the switch to a Philips Sonicare toothbrush and feel the difference.

Important Information

Safety Information

Keep out of reach of children.

Directions

Wet the toothbrush head and apply toothpaste. Guide the toothbrush along all tooth surfaces in a gentle, circular motion. Brush the tongue and inside of cheeks. Brush for two minutes. Replace the brush head every three months. Refer to the user manual for specific instructions related to charging and using different modes.
